problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select packages for a delivery truck. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 36 cubic feet, revenue $268
* Package B: size 21 cubic feet, revenue $197
* Package C: size 38 cubic feet, revenue $22
* Package D: size 9 cubic feet, revenue $212
* Package E: size 10 cubic feet, revenue $100
* Package F: size 33 cubic feet, revenue $49
* Package G: size 9 cubic feet, revenue $115
* Package H: size 50 cubic feet, revenue $264
* Package I: size 37 cubic feet, revenue $119
* Package J: size 16 cubic feet, revenue $77
* Package K: size 15 cubic feet, revenue $206
The truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 191 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
